title: Comparative Analysis of State-of-the-Art Foundation Models for Sleep Analysis Under Channel Reduction
abstract: arXiv:2609.22105v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic sleep staging from polysomnography (PSG) is a well-studied task, but PSG itself is expensive, clinic-based, and burdensome to manually score, which limits its use for long-term or at-home monitoring. Most existing sleep-staging foundation models are evaluated using the full PSG montage. We instead ask how much of that montage is actually necessary. We evaluate six sleep staging models on the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA) PSG dataset across three signal conditions: electroencephalography (EEG), electrocardiography (ECG), and their combination (EEG+ECG). This is motivated by edge-cloud deployment, where EEG requires a clinic-grade scalp electrode, whereas ECG is already captured by consumer wearables. translated_title: 信道削减条件下最先进基础模型在睡眠分析中的比较研究
translated_abstract: 从多导睡眠图（PSG）中自动进行睡眠分期是一个已被广泛研究的任务，但PSG本身价格昂贵、需在临床环境中进行，且人工评分负担繁重，这限制了其在长期或居家监测中的应用。大多数现有的睡眠分期基础模型都是使用完整的PSG导联组合进行评估的，而我们则反问：这些导联中究竟有多少是真正必要的？我们在多种族动脉粥样硬化研究（MESA）PSG数据集上，于三种信号条件下评估了六个睡眠分期模型：脑电图（EEG）、心电图（ECG）以及两者的组合（EEG+ECG）。这一研究的动机来自端云部署场景：EEG需要临床级的头皮电极，而ECG已可由消费级可穿戴设备采集。我们测试了诸如在MESA上从头训练编码器的SleepFM等最先进基础模型，以及BIOT、MOMENT、LaBraM，还有一个基础规模（ViT-B）的SensorLM复现模型……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该论文在MESA数据集上比较了六种最先进的睡眠分期基础模型在EEG、ECG及其组合三种信道削减条件下的表现，为面向端云部署的低成本居家睡眠监测提供了模型选择依据。
